pidex-big-explain-sub: Pi Network's Own Built-In Exchange — Live Since March 12, 2026
pidex-big-explain-p1: Think of it like this: A regular market where people buy and sell goods — except instead of tomatoes and bread, people are exchanging Pi tokens for other digital tokens, directly with each other, with no middleman taking a cut.
pidex-big-explain-p2: PiDEX stands for Pi Decentralized Exchange. It lives inside your Pi Wallet and Pi Browser. It uses a system called an Automated Market Maker (AMM) — a smart computer programme that automatically sets fair prices based on supply and demand, just like a market does naturally.
pidex-big-explain-tip: Simple version: PiDEX = a marketplace inside Pi where you can exchange your Pi for other project tokens — safely, without leaving the Pi ecosystem.
pidex-big-c1-body: You trade directly with other pioneers. No bank, no broker, no exchange company taking large fees. The Pi blockchain handles the transaction automatically and safely.
pidex-big-c2-body: Think of a pool of water. Pioneers add their Pi to a shared pool. When someone wants to swap tokens, they draw from this pool. In return, pool contributors earn a small reward — called a liquidity fee.
pidex-big-c3-body: No human sets prices on PiDEX. A smart mathematical formula automatically calculates fair prices based on how much of each token is available in the pool. More demand = higher price. More supply = lower price.
pidex-big-c4-body: Not just ANY token can appear on PiDEX. Pi Network reviews and approves tokens before they're listed — protecting pioneers from scam tokens and worthless projects.
pidex-big-c5-body: PiDEX helps establish the REAL value of Pi — based on actual trading activity, not speculation. Every swap on PiDEX is a vote for what Pi is truly worth.
pidex-big-c6-body: A tiny fee paid to process your transaction on the blockchain. On PiDEX, fees are kept very low — making it accessible to African pioneers with small balances.

pidex-big-s4-desc: Select which tokens you want to swap — e.g. Pi → [Project Token].
pidex-big-s5-desc: Type how much Pi you want to swap. Review the rate and fees.
pidex-big-s6-desc: Tap Confirm — the Pi blockchain handles the rest automatically.

pidex-big-gcv-p1: Every swap on PiDEX contributes to real price discovery. Unlike speculative prices on outside exchanges, PiDEX reflects actual utility and demand within the Pi ecosystem.
pidex-big-gcv-p2: As more African pioneers use PiDEX — buying goods, paying for services, swapping tokens — the true value of Pi becomes visible on-chain. This is the foundation that makes GCV adoption credible and unstoppable.

pidex-big-sf1-body: PiDEX is ONLY accessible inside Pi Wallet in Pi Browser. Any website or app claiming to be "PiDEX" outside of Pi Browser is a SCAM. Never connect your wallet to external sites.

pilaunch-big-faq2-a: Yes. KYC verification is required to participate in Pi Launchpad. Complete your KYC inside the Pi app first. Without KYC your Pi Wallet is not fully active and you cannot participate in launches.
pilaunch-big-faq3-q: What is the difference between staking and committing?
pilaunch-big-faq3-a: Staking = reserving your Pi (like raising your hand). Committing = actually sending Pi to the pool (like paying). You MUST do both to earn tokens. Staking alone earns you nothing. Many pioneers in the first test launch made this mistake — do not repeat it!
pilaunch-big-faq4-q: Can African developers launch their own projects on Pi Launchpad?
pilaunch-big-faq4-a: Yes! Any developer with a working Pi app can apply to launch through Pi Launchpad. This is a massive opportunity for African developers to create Pi-powered solutions for Africa's 1.4 billion people — and raise Pi liquidity from the community.
pilaunch-big-faq5-q: Where does my Pi go when I commit to a launch?
pilaunch-big-faq5-a: Your Pi goes into a liquidity pool — NOT into the project team's wallet. This pool pairs your Pi with the new project token, making it immediately tradeable on PiDEX. This design prevents rug pulls and ensures the token has real liquidity from launch day.
pilaunch-big-faq6-q: What happens to Testnet tokens after Mainnet launches?
pilaunch-big-faq6-a: Testnet tokens (like the test token and SLICE) will NOT transfer to Mainnet. They are only for practice and learning. When Mainnet launches, new real token launches will begin. Your advantage is that you will already know how the system works!
pilaunch-big-faq7-q: How is Pi Launchpad different from regular crypto ICOs?
pilaunch-big-faq7-a: Traditional crypto ICOs often raise money with just a whitepaper — no working product. Pi Launchpad requires projects to have a WORKING APP before launching. Money goes to liquidity pools, not founders. This makes Pi Launchpad far safer for pioneers than typical crypto fundraising.
